note: hidden = final-layer decoder hidden state at the generation step that produced the last content token of the greedy answer (flan-t5-small, encoder-decoder; the original SEP paper ablates decoder-only models, so this is one clearly-defined choice rather than a reproduction of their full layer/position sweep). sep_regression targets the cached SE value from the original 6-condition run; sep_classifier and the AUROC ground truth both use this run's own greedy label. CAVEAT: sep_regression and sep_classifier are compared here under a same-distribution GroupKFold-by-qid split, not the cross-task/cross-dataset distribution shift that the original paper's generalisation claim (SE-regression generalises better than a probe trained directly on the label) concerns; this comparison neither confirms nor refutes that claim.
